What we do

The Services

Everything from a quick tidy-up to a proper hot-towel wet shave. Straightforward gents' barbering done well — and no appointment needed for any of it.

Hair Cuts

Clipper work, scissor work or a bit of both. Tell Darren what you're after, or leave it to him.

Re-styles

Fancy a change? A proper consultation first, then a cut that actually suits your head and your hair.

Wash, Cut & Finish

The full sit-down: shampoo at the basin, cut, then styled and finished with product.

Wet Shaves

Hot towel, warm lather and a traditional razor. The closest shave you'll get anywhere.

Beard Trims

Shaped, tidied and lined out — from a light neaten-up to a full reshape.

Head Shaves

Clean, smooth and comfortable, finished with a hot towel and balm.

Crew Cuts

Sharp, simple and quick. In, done, out the door.

Boys & OAPs

Little ones and older gents looked after, with a bit of patience and a friendlier rate.

Colouring & Highlights

Grey blending, full colour or highlights — subtle or bold, your call.

Ear Piercing

Done properly and hygienically in the chair, with aftercare advice included.

Product Sales

Clays, pastes, pomades and beard oils — the same kit we use on you, to take home.

Prices

Ask in the shop or give us a ring — we'll always tell you before we start.

The barbers

Darren & Stella Endean

Endean's is a traditional & modern gents' hairdressers on Harbour Road in Par, run together by husband-and-wife team Darren and Stella Endean. It's a proper local barber shop — you're not a booking slot, you're whoever walked through the door.

In June 2020 Darren was examined and accredited by the British Master Barbers Alliance as an official British Master Barber — a standard that looks hard at barbering skill, professionalism, hygiene and how a shop is run. There aren't many of them in Cornwall.

The shop is a relaxed one: coffee on the side, telly on the wall, free Wi-Fi, and an autism-friendly welcome for anyone who finds a haircut hard going. Take your time — nobody's rushing you out.
